# WebCrawler.buzz: Full Technical Documentation

> Free web-based website crawler for SEO audits. Crawls any publicly accessible domain and returns structured page-level data.
> Website: https://webcrawler.buzz
> Source: https://github.com/devhasibulislam/webcrawler (MIT License)

## Product Overview

WebCrawler.buzz is a free website crawling tool built for SEO professionals, developers, and website owners. It performs breadth-first search (BFS) crawling scoped to a root domain and extracts detailed page-level SEO data.

No registration required. No API key needed. Paste a URL, click "Start Crawl," and view results in your browser.

## How It Works

1. **Submit a URL**, Enter any website URL on the homepage
2. **Duplicate Detection**, If the domain was already crawled recently, you can view existing results or start a fresh re-crawl
3. **BFS Crawling**, The crawler visits every discoverable page on the domain, staying within the root domain scope
4. **Real-Time Progress**, Live progress bar with percentage updates (polls every 5 seconds)
5. **Tracking URL**, Shareable bookmark link to check progress or results anytime
6. **Email Notification**, Optionally enter your email to get notified when the crawl completes
7. **View Results**, Paginated table with all crawled pages and their SEO data
8. **Export CSV**, Export full results as a CSV file, delivered via email

## Data Collected Per Page

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| URL | Full URL of the crawled page |
| Page Title | Content of the `<title>` tag |
| Meta Description | Content of `<meta name="description">` |
| HTTP Status Code | Response status (200, 301, 404, 500, etc.) |
| Response Time | Time to receive response in milliseconds |
| Content Type | MIME type (text/html, application/json, etc.) |
| Page Size | Response body size in bytes |
| Internal Links Count | Links pointing to pages on the same domain |
| External Links Count | Links pointing to other domains |
| Redirect URL | Final destination if the page redirected |
| Indexable | Whether the page is indexable by search engines |
| Discovered At | Timestamp when the page was first found |

## Features

### No Registration Required
Completely free. No account, no API keys, no page limits per crawl.

### Real-Time Progress Tracking
Live progress bar updates every 5 seconds showing pages crawled vs. total discovered.

### Shareable Tracking URLs
Each crawl gets a unique URL. Bookmark it or share it, works across devices and sessions.

### Duplicate Domain Detection
If a domain was recently crawled, you can view existing results or start a fresh crawl.

### Email Notifications
Enter your email during a crawl to receive a notification with a direct link when it completes.

### Paginated Results
Clean table view with pagination options: 50, 100, 500, or 1000 results per page.

### CSV Export
One-click export. CSV delivered to your email within minutes. Download links valid for 5 minutes.

## REST API

Base URL: `https://api.webcrawler.buzz`

> **Important:** Use `api.webcrawler.buzz` for all programmatic/automated access. The main domain (webcrawler.buzz) is behind Cloudflare bot protection and will return 403 to non-browser clients.

### Start a Crawl
```
POST /api/crawl
Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "url": "https://example.com" }

Response 201:
{ "job_id": "uuid", "tracking_url": "/results?job_id=uuid", "domain": "example.com" }
```

### Handle Duplicate Domain
```
POST /api/crawl/decide
Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "domain": "example.com", "action": "re-crawl" | "use-existing" }
```

### Get Crawl Progress
```
GET /api/crawl/:jobId/progress

Response 200:
{
  "job_id": "uuid",
  "status": "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "pending",
  "progress_percent": 45,
  "total_pages_found": 23,
  "total_pages_queued": 51
}
```

### Get Crawl Results (Paginated)
```
GET /api/crawl/:jobId?page=1&limit=50

Response 200:
{
  "job_id": "uuid",
  "domain": "example.com",
  "status": "completed",
  "total_pages_found": 150,
  "pages": [...],
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 50, "total_pages": 3, "total_results": 150 }
}
```

### Register Email Notification
```
POST /api/crawl/:jobId/notify
Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "email": "user@example.com" }
```

### Request CSV Export
```
POST /api/crawl/:jobId/export
Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "email": "user@example.com" }
```

### Check Export Status
```
GET /api/crawl/:jobId/export/status

Response 200:
{ "active": true, "status": "processing" | "completed" | "sent", "email": "user@example.com" }
```

### Download CSV
```
GET /api/crawl/:jobId/export/download/:exportId

Response: CSV file stream (valid for 5 minutes after generation)
```

### Health Check
```
GET /api/health

Response 200: { "status": "ok", "db_latency_ms": 5, "redis_latency_ms": 2 }
```

### Public Stats
```
GET /api/stats

Response 200: { "total_jobs": 1234, "total_pages_crawled": 56789, "unique_domains": 890 }
```

## Rate Limits

- 200 POST requests per 15-minute window per IP
- GET requests are exempt (progress polling works without limits)
- Crawl queue concurrency: 5 simultaneous jobs
- Export queue concurrency: 2 simultaneous exports

## Data Retention

- Crawl results auto-delete after 1 hour
- CSV export files auto-delete after 5 minutes
- No permanent data storage, all results are ephemeral

## Technical Stack

- **Backend**: Express.js v5, TypeScript (strict mode)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL
- **Queue**: BullMQ with Redis
- **Crawling**: axios (HTTP) + cheerio (HTML parsing)
- **Email**: Nodemailer (Gmail SMTP)
- **Deployment**: PM2 on Ubuntu VPS behind Cloudflare + Nginx
- **Frontend**: Static HTML, Tailwind CSS, vanilla JavaScript

## Database Schema

### crawl_jobs
| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Primary key |
| domain | VARCHAR(255) | Root domain being crawled |
| input_url | TEXT | Original URL submitted |
| status | VARCHAR(20) | pending, running, completed, failed |
| total_pages_found | INTEGER | Pages discovered so far |
| total_pages_queued | INTEGER | Pages in BFS queue |
| notify_email | VARCHAR(255) | Email for completion notification |
| error_message | TEXT | Error details if failed |
| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Job creation time |
| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Last status update |

### crawled_pages
| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Primary key |
| job_id | UUID | FK → crawl_jobs.id |
| url | TEXT | Full page URL |
| page_title | TEXT | Title tag content |
| meta_description | TEXT | Meta description content |
| status_code | INTEGER | HTTP response code |
| response_time_ms | INTEGER | Response time |
| content_type | VARCHAR(255) | MIME type |
| page_size_bytes | INTEGER | Response body size |
| internal_links_count | INTEGER | Same-domain link count |
| external_links_count | INTEGER | External link count |
| redirect_url | TEXT | Redirect destination |
| is_indexable | BOOLEAN | Indexability status |
| discovered_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Discovery timestamp |

### csv_exports
| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Primary key |
| job_id | UUID | FK → crawl_jobs.id |
| email | VARCHAR(255) | Recipient email |
| file_path | TEXT | Server file path |
| status | VARCHAR(20) | processing, completed, sent |
| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Export request time |

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is this crawler free?**
Yes. No hidden costs, no registration, no page limits.

**How long does a crawl take?**
Small sites (under 100 pages): under a minute. Larger sites: several minutes. Bookmark the tracking URL and return later.

**Can I crawl any website?**
Any publicly accessible website. The crawler stays within the root domain boundary.

**How long are results available?**
Crawl results expire after 1 hour. CSV downloads expire after 5 minutes. You can always re-crawl.

**Is there an API?**
Yes. All endpoints documented above. No API key required.

**Can I crawl a site I don't own?**
The crawler only accesses publicly available pages (like Googlebot). Use responsibly.
